referenceFunction.generalComment: The data represent a typical Laptop PC mainboard, used in modern computers. Material data are taken from the literature plus from own estimations and assumptions. Infrastructure and production efforts are based on own assumptions. An update was made in 2023, comprising: modification to energy consumption and regionalization of inventory flows, such as energy and metal input (Duque Ciceri et al., 2010; Kupka et al., 2018.); Geography: Data represent a global valuable composition of Laptop PC mainboards.; UUID: 0cb84959-3b34-3668-8025-edda3120c2a6
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset covers component input and production efforts (incl. PWB waste due to failure in mounting) for the production of Laptop PC mainboards, using Pb-free solder material.
